summary: Only the two image tags of the monitoring stack change (Prometheus v3.5.0 -> v3.15.1, Grafana 12.2.0 -> 13.3.0) plus a changelog line. Ports, bind addresses, users, volumes, environment, secrets handling, health checks, provisioning and deploy_ct.py are unchanged. Traced the upstream release notes for both ranges: no removed flag or provisioning key that the stack uses; Prometheus 3.13 stops sending basic_auth on cross-host redirects of a target (stricter); Grafana 13 disables the numeric data source id APIs by default (the provisioned data source and dashboard use uid only), keeps sign-up and anonymous access as configured, and migrates dashboards and folders into unified storage on first start, which has no in-place downgrade. The changelog tells operators to copy grafana-data while Grafana is stopped before rolling out. No new trust boundary, route or credential path.

findings.evidence: monitoring/compose.yaml references both images by mutable tag, not by digest; a re-pushed tag would change what deploy_ct.py starts.
findings.resolution: Pre-existing: the previous tags were mutable in the same way. This change does not introduce it; pinning by digest belongs to TM-16's next action (pin/lock).

tests.command: Operator probe: copy of an existing grafana-data (taken with Grafana stopped) started once with grafana/grafana:12.2.0 and once with 13.3.0, no network, provisioning mounted read-only as in compose.yaml
tests.evidence: 13.3.0 healthy after about 14 s; log 'Unified storage migrations completed successfully'; the same 22 dashboards (by uid), the same folder and the same data sources (name, type, uid) as 12.2.0; memory 262 MiB under the 768 MiB limit of that deployment (139 MiB with 12.2.0).

tests.command: Operator probe with HTTPS and the deployment's certificate: the compose health check command `wget -q --no-check-certificate -O /dev/null https://127.0.0.1:3000/api/health` inside grafana/grafana:13.3.0
tests.evidence: Succeeds; wget in the 13.3.0 image is still busybox, as in 12.2.0.

tests.command: Prometheus v3.15.1 with the same flag style (retention flags, web.listen-address, remote-write receiver) and busybox wget health check, run by the operator in a separate stack
tests.evidence: Container healthy, /-/ready answered, rules and remote write working after the switch from v3.14.0; the prom/prometheus image of this repo was not started yet.

limitations: deploy_ct.py was not run with the new tags; the operator rolls out after the merge and keeps the grafana-data copy until the stack is healthy.
Grafana 13 memory with only this repository's dashboard was not measured; the probe used a larger dashboard set and stayed at 262 MiB, the stock limit here is 384 MiB.
--storage.tsdb.retention.time is marked deprecated in current Prometheus docs (still working in v3.15.1); moving retention into the config file is left for a later change.
No CI job starts the containers; image behaviour is covered only by the operator probes above.
